sections.title: Startup and Commercialization
bullets: Co-founded CaiqueTech in 2024 (with Alex Lee) and established PI SpeedLAB brand plus U.S. entity foundation.
Developed PI SpeedGun / PI Link, a smartphone USB-C connected 24GHz modular radar.
Designed app features for real-time speed display, logging, video capture, and day-by-day analytics.
Validated the product at CES 2025/2026, SPOEX 2025, and KT Wiz fan demo events.
Kickstarter campaign 'PI-Link: Turn Your Smartphone Into a Smart Speed Radar' funded: 511 backers, $80,340 pledged (vs. $2,000 goal).
Combined Doppler radar module with smartphone-side compute to deliver a lighter and more affordable speed gun than legacy devices.
Verified performance: 210 kbps effective iOS BLE throughput secured; outbound data rate reduced from 240 kbps to 110 kbps (BLE notification and 509-byte chunked transmission).
Signal quality: 8 dB noise floor improvement, detection range extended from 2 m to 5 m, miss rate cut from 7% to under 1% and false-detection rate from 6% to under 1% across 1,000 pitches.
Productization: first production run of 600 units based on verification results, with FCC, KC, CE, and TELEC radio certification support.
Developed Python-based Doppler test and analysis programs (power spectrum, spectrogram, CFAR) and built an HIL closed-loop verification environment linking PCB, smartphone, PC, and J-Link.

sections.title: Development Skill Set
sections.subtitle: Hardware + Mobile + Productization
bullets: Sensor fusion design: detachable Doppler radar module integrated with smartphone camera workflow.
Mobile integration design: USB-C connected hardware and app experience architecture.
Data features: speed measurement, history logging, video-linked records, and trend analysis.
Product engineering: prototype development, demo deployment, certification planning (KC/FCC), manufacturing readiness.
Business execution: MOU partnerships, international exhibitions, and crowdfunding go-to-market strategy.
Tech stack: Python (6 years), Dart (3 years), Shell Script, STM32F373 MCU firmware (20 kHz signal acquisition via DMA/Ring Buffer), BLE (Renesas DA14531).
Compression/transmission: Delta lossless and ADPCM lossy compression implementations; BLE notification and 509-byte chunked transmission optimization.
Joint research with Kyung Hee University AE Lab (advisor: Prof. Sang-hyuk Kim) - CFAR parameter tuning and staged root-cause isolation from circuit to signal processing with iterative verification.
